description: Archive scripts out of the user's working plan, by id — or restore archived ones with `restore: true`. Archiving is reversible and keeps the script and any recorded video; it is the right way to clear finished or shelved work. Permanent deletion is deliberately not available to assistants — the user does that themselves.

ids.description: The scripts to archive (or restore). Ids come from list_planned_scripts.

restore.description: true brings archived scripts back into the plan instead. Default false.

name: archive_planned_scripts
title: Archive planned scripts
